subject: POC Onboarding & RACI — next steps and success criteria
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: POC Onboarding & RACI — next steps and success criteria

Hi Sara / Luis —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As promised, heres a concise recap and a proposed structure for the 4-week evaluation so we can sync on owners and success criteria. I attached a working spreadsheet (POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx) and a lightweight RACI CSV.

High-level goals for the trial (what OliveTech needs to validate):
- Verify inference latency at 99th percentile for your peak customer workflow (~1.5k tokens) under expected concurrency.
- Validate integrated auth & data-flow with your staging VPC (no traffic leaves your network).
- Confirm cost profile per 1k requests with Redwood batching/kv-cache enabled.
- Assess output quality on the 50-case testplan you shared.

Proposed timeline (summary):
Week 0 (this week): infra prep & contract sign (net 7 on the MSA).
Week 1: private deployment in your staging VPC & initial smoke tests.
Week 2: run 50-case eval set + latency/cost benchmarking.
Week 3: iterate on prompts/quantization settings; final acceptance run.

Suggested RACI (short):
- Infra (VPC, network rules): Responsible = OliveTech (Luis), Consulted = Redwood infra (Karthik), Accountable = OliveTech Engineering lead.
- App integration (SDK, routing): Responsible = OliveTech devs, Support = Redwood SE (Marissa/Karthik).
- Security & compliance (KMS, audit logs): Responsible = OliveTech SecOps, Informed = Redwood SOC/Compliance.
- Procurement / PO: Responsible = OliveTech procurement, Informed = Redwood (Neha).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm Luis will own infra prep and share a time window for VPC peering or private link? (Luis: ping on availability)
2) Please sign the attached short SOW and return via DocuSign (Ill send the link once we have greenlight).
3) Karthik: can you confirm the expected image/quantization well provision for the trial and any required test credentials?

If that all looks good Ill book a 30-min kickoff for Friday to walk through the RACI and assign person-level tasks in the tracker.

Thanks —
Neha
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: POC Onboarding & RACI — next steps and success criteria

Sara / team — quick technical clarifications from my side to unblock SecOps and infra planning:

1) Network & access
- Redwood only needs network-level connectivity to the private endpoint we provision (private link or VPC peering). No host-level SSH/RDP access is required.
- We will request the following outbound access for the test harness: 169.254.170.0/24 (metadata) and to our metrics endpoint via TLS on 443. We can provide specific FQDNs for allowlisting.

2) Key management & logs
- KMS: If you want customer-managed keys, Redwood supports integrating a customer KMS; SecOps will need the KMS key ARN and an IAM role with encrypt/decrypt permissions. Otherwise we can use a temporary key with full logging.
- Audit logs: Redwood can stream model invocation logs and platform audit logs to your S3 bucket (or your SIEM) for the duration of the trial. Retention defaults to 90 days; we can shorten per your policy.

3) Image/quantization and test creds
- For the first run I recommend the 8-bit quantized variant of the 7B model (balanced latency/cost). If you expect longer context we can provision an L2 variant (higher memory).
- I will produce a small credentials package (readonly API key and a scoped role) for the smoke tests; those will expire at the end of the trial.

I attached a minimal RACI export (Redwood-OLV-RACI.csv) that maps individuals to responsibilities; please review and flag mismatches.

Karthik
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — collating a few operational notes so the Friday kickoff is efficient:

- Tasks to complete before kickoff:

  * Sara: confirm the 50-case test set (we got the sample but need full list).

- Acceptance criteria (short):

  * Evaluation report with sample outputs and cost delta vs baseline (delivered within 3 business days of final run).

If everyone agrees Ill create JIRA tasks for each owner (links in the kickoff notes) and track the RACI updates there.

Monica
